teaser.en: A Digo mushroom with a lively, repeating name and, as yet, no scientific identity.
teaser.sw: Uyoga wa Kidigo wenye jina changamfu linalojirudia na, hadi sasa, bila utambulisho wa kisayansi.

summary.en: Gadugadu is a mushroom known to Digo collectors that has not yet been scientifically identified. Pakia records only its name.
summary.sw: Gadugadu ni uyoga unaojulikana na wakusanyaji wa Kidigo ambao bado haujatambuliwa kisayansi. Pakia anarekodi jina lake tu.

about.en: *Gadugadu* is a mushroom that Digo collectors know by name but that has not yet been scientifically identified. Pakia notes that some of the mushrooms he collected were still awaiting identification when his study was written. Digo collectors tell mushrooms apart mainly by the colour of the cap, but no description of *gadugadu* is recorded.
about.sw: *gadugadu* ni uyoga ambao wakusanyaji wa Kidigo wanaujua kwa jina lakini bado haujatambuliwa kisayansi. Pakia anaeleza kuwa baadhi ya uyoga aliokusanya ulikuwa bado unasubiri kutambuliwa wakati utafiti wake ulipoandikwa. Wakusanyaji wa Kidigo hutofautisha uyoga hasa kwa rangi ya kofia, lakini hakuna maelezo ya *gadugadu* yaliyorekodiwa.

where.en: Digo mushroom collectors recognise three mushroom grounds: *Brachystegia* woodland (*mirihini*), farmland (*mdani*) and termite mounds (*tsuluni*). Which of these this mushroom favours is not recorded.
where.sw: Wakusanyaji wa uyoga wa Kidigo wanatambua maeneo matatu ya uyoga: msitu wa *Brachystegia* (*mirihini*), mashamba (*mdani*) na vichuguu (*tsuluni*). Haijarekodiwa ni lipi kati ya haya ambalo uyoga huu hupendelea.

uses.en: Pakia notes that the Digo give names only to mushrooms they know as edible, so *gadugadu* is very likely one that local people collect and eat. Wild mushrooms should only be eaten when identified by someone with expert local knowledge.
uses.sw: Pakia anaeleza kuwa Wadigo huipa majina uyoga tu wanaoujua kuwa unalika, kwa hiyo huenda sana *gadugadu* ni mmoja wa uyoga ambao wenyeji hukusanya na kula. Uyoga wa porini unapaswa kuliwa tu ukiwa umetambuliwa na mtu mwenye ujuzi wa kina wa kienyeji.

culture.en: Mushroom collecting is women's work among the Digo. Pakia found that only about ten kinds, those learnt from the elders as edible, are eaten, and that collectors pick them young, with the cap still closed (*fundula*), because open caps (*bumula*) are usually full of worms.
culture.sw: Kukusanya uyoga ni kazi ya wanawake miongoni mwa Wadigo. Pakia aligundua kuwa ni aina takriban kumi tu zinazoliwa, zile ambazo wazee walifundisha kuwa zinalika, na kwamba wakusanyaji huzichuma zikiwa changa, kofia ikiwa bado imefunga (*fundula*), kwa sababu kofia zilizofunguka (*bumula*) kwa kawaida hujaa funza.

names.en: Pakia records *gadugadu*; the meaning is not explained. Repeated names like this are common in Digo plant names, where the repetition often means 'in the manner of'.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *gadugadu*; maana yake haielezwi. Majina yanayojirudia kama hili ni ya kawaida katika majina ya mimea ya Kidigo, ambapo kurudiwa huko mara nyingi kunamaanisha 'kwa namna ya'.
